[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-29[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Close the running Pomodoro with =x in bob capture and Bob Mac [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Capture[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A capture item `=x` closes today's running Pomodoro exactly the way[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Obsidian's Pomodoro completion does, and also shortens a session [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]stopped early. The forms `@route:block-id=x`, `^route:block-id=x`, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and `<text> @route:block-id=x` first put that task into the running[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]session. Every close is atomic. A missing, ambiguous, or malformed [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]target gives an actionable diagnostic. Bob Mac Capture shows a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]rich, accurate preview of the session about to close.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202609/capture_pomodoro_close.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-29/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pomodoro close engine, daily-note half[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]close-ledger[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]close-ledger: add a pure module that finds the running Pomodoro and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]computes the early-stop auto-decrement. It ports Obsidian's completion [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rewrite of the daily note: sub-bullet classification, tomato markers, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]deferred-link removal, and carrying links into a new placeholder. It [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]exposes the planned task effects and Work Log note groups as data, with [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]unit tests pinned to the worked example.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Pomodoro close engine, linked-task effects and Work Log[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]close-tasks[dim] · [dim][/dim]after close-ledger[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]close-tasks: share task-status-hooks' vault link resolver. Port the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]linked-task side of completion: start bare-linked tasks `\[/]`, close [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]embedded targets recursively with a completion date, write dated Work [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Log entries, and retire closed embeds. Wrap both halves in one [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`plan_pomodoro_close` entry point over an injectable vault, with unit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]=x grammar, atomic capture transaction, and outputs[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]close-capture[dim] · [dim][/dim]after close-tasks[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]close-capture: recognize whole-item `=x` and the `=x` suffix on solo [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`@`/`^` links and body-bearing `:` captures, together with their [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]near-miss and conflict errors. Wire the close through [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]CaptureBatchPlanner, including the link-into-running step. Emit the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`pomodoro_close` kind and object plus human output, point the start [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]guards at `=x`, and add integration tests.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Editor contract, help, and docs for =x[/bold #D7AFFF]                        [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]close-editor-contract[dim] · [dim][/dim]after close-capture[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]close-editor-contract: add the capture-parse `pomodoro_close` mode, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]span, spec, incomplete state, and `invalid_pomodoro_close` diagnostics. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Make capture-complete and capture-rewrite ignore the close suffix. [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Update the help for capture, capture-parse, and capture-complete, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]update docs/capture.md, the task-status-hooks note, and the README.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Bob Mac Capture close preview, footer, and notifications[/bold #D7AFFF]      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]mac-close-preview[dim] · [dim][/dim]after close-capture[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]mac-close-preview: in bob-mac-capture, decode the additive [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`pomodoro_close` contract. Render the dedicated close card (session, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]timing chip, task rows with transitions and Work Log previews, next [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]session), including the variants for link and new-task closes. Add the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Close footer and notifications, fix stale preview state, and add [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]fake-bob fixtures generated from real bob output, tests, README updates,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and green macOS CI.[/#D7D7AF]
